notes.title: Update 3.0.3 is out!
notes.content:
3.0.3:

Bug fixes:
 -Fixed not being able to shoot in multiplayer.
 -Fixed the game crashing with certain controllers.
 -Fixed game sometime randomly crashing after defeating the boss in the lab map.
 -Fixed the game crashing if you pressed two buttons at the same time in the menus.
 -Fixed the game randomly crashing regarding the lightning system.
 -Optimized the lightning system.
